ops.text: 15.4 Product Warranty; Remedy. Array represents and warrants that all Materials supplied to Ono by or on behalf of Array under Article 9 shall, at the time of delivery, (a) conform in all material respects to the applicable product specifications, (b) have been Manufactured in accordance with GMP and all other applicable Law, and (c) be free from any lien or encumbrance. Ono may reject any Materials that fail to comply with the foregoing warranty by written notice given within ninety (90) days after delivery or, in the case of latent defects not reasonably discoverable upon inspection, within ninety (90) days after discovery thereof, and Array shall, at Array's option, promptly replace such Materials at no additional cost to Ono or refund the amounts paid by Ono for such Materials.

input.comment: [Playbook] We added an express warranty that Materials supplied under Article 9 conform to specifications and are Manufactured under GMP and applicable Law, with a ninety (90) day replace-or-refund remedy, since the Agreement currently gives us only Effective Date representations and defers conformance entirely to supply agreements not yet signed. Our playbook requires a conformance warranty with a real remedy; we are happy to align the mechanics with the clinical/commercial Quality Agreements.
input.summary: Insert product conformance/GMP warranty with 90-day replace-or-refund remedy for Materials supplied by Array.
